note: Which counts decide what, and the conventions the engine follows. This file is copied into every language pack when it is built; the engine reads it from the pack. Editing the pack changes how the system reads without touching code.

name_matching.meaning: another name for it, from the word pack
the same text once blank space is removed
the question's name ends with the passage's name after a space; the words in front are reported

conventions.partial_reading_blocks_whole_meaning: false: a reading that ignores words never stands in the way of a reading that explains every word with pieces seen in the lessons. true: it does when it scores clearly higher, as before 2026-11-23.
conventions.contradicted_reading_blocks_meaning: false: a higher-scoring reading holds the text back only when what it relies on was never observed either way (0 of 0). One that goes against what the lessons showed (0 of N) does not. true: any higher-scoring reading with a zero count holds the text, as before 2026-11-23.
conventions.attachment_check_meaning: true: a reading is not accepted when one of its parts could, by the form of the sentence, equally belong to another head (a time in front of a chain, for one). The reader holds and says between which words the choice lies. Absent or false: the place the counts prefer is taken, as before 2026-11-23.
conventions.lesson_words_meaning: make_way: on a field's word pack the lessons' own words of that slot stop being readable; their counts stay as the pooled form field words get. Absent: they stay, and a field word equal to one is refused.
conventions.role_check_meaning: true: a reading is not accepted when the connector after a word of unknown kind was also seen marking another role its head does not have; the reader holds and names the roles. Absent: the role the counts prefer is taken.
conventions.open_role_answers_meaning: assume: one word's role is open and its kind unknown: each reading the form allows is tried against the knowledge; if exactly one is answered, it is given with status 'assumed' and a report. Otherwise, and when absent, the user is asked. Questions only.
conventions.unasked_parts_meaning: block: a fact answers a question only if the question names every part the fact has (circumstance, time, condition, denial). Absent: a fact with more parts than asked about still answers.
conventions.name_joins_meaning: value: X의 P의 Q is answered from two facts stated apart, joined through the name that is the value of the first and stands in that role of the second. Not counted as verified. Absent: only what one sentence states together is matched.
conventions.word_kinds_meaning: where_open: what is known about a word's kind is used only where the connector after it leaves its role open (free values were seen in more than one role in front of it). Elsewhere the form decides. Absent: a word of known kind is that kind wherever it stands.
conventions.unread_question_answers_meaning: anchor: an unread question is put to the knowledge the other way round. One plain fact fits and every other piece is accounted for: 'assumed'. A piece left over: a proposal, no answer. Several facts: listed. Absent: held.
conventions.reading_uses_knowledge_meaning: true: a word the knowledge uses is known, when a question is read, as the kind it was read as there (where the form leaves the role open). Absent: lessons, lists and packs only.
conventions.close_readings_meaning: ask_knowledge: the reader cannot choose between fully seen readings: each is put to the knowledge; if those answered agree, status 'assumed' with all readings tried. Absent: held.
conventions.partial_answers_meaning: withhold: no answer is given when words of the question were ignored or a name was matched by ignoring the words in front of it; the candidate is kept as withheld. give: the answer is given with a flag, as before 2026-11-23. A name that differs only in spacing is not affected.

known_names.meaning: a name the field pack knows is a known piece: found inside a longer free value it is a piece left unused, unless that value is itself a name or a value the pack states
